title_sq: AMBIENT KOMERCIAL NE SHITJE, "BOOK BUILDING_POLI FUNKSIONALE", SHESHI SKERNDERBEJ!
description_sq:
Ne shitje ambient komercial, i vendosur tek "Book Buliding_Plan Funksional".
Me nje siperfaqe 147.74 m2.
Pozicionuar ne katin e 3, te nje prej ndertimeve me elitare te zones.

title_en: COMMERCIAL ENVIRONMENT FOR SALE, "BOOK BUILDING_POLI FUNCTIONALE", SKERNDERBEJ SQUARE!
